Literally the best pet shop I’ve been to! The owners are truly amazing and you can tell they care so much about their animals and customers. Love that the bettas are actually living in a proper setup tank unlike the cups you’re used to at large scale pet stores. Prices are so reasonable as well and when I mentioned my cats might not like certain treats, they were so ready to provide samples to let them try.
Could not recommend a better spot to buy your supplies especially considering the fact that they do delivery as well 👯‍♀️

PS. the cats loved the sardine treat samples!!
Great store that has been a pleasure to work with. My MBK arrived in good health and fine shape.

Absolutely amazing store and team. His passion, expertise and knowledge about reptiles and other animals and plants is so clearly evident and the end result speaks for itself.

Thank you Josh and can’t wait to be back for all our reptile and pet needs!

I know it is a great store. I think the staff are very knowledgeable and responsible (They would not sell my friend fish because he did not have the 'correct' water (just right from the faucet) for the fish to survive in) they explained to him what to do...and it was correct. However, when I went, there  and that was no accessibility and that really frustrated me. However, in their defence, the salesperson did come down to serve me, and once again he was knowledgeable about my request. I would have given them a five but because of NO accessibility I could only give them a three. I really hope, if they haven't already, they make it accessible.
Excellent shop, very happy for all the help!  Highly recommend

Amazing customer service

The Beastiary is our go-to pet store and for good reason! The animals are healthy, well-cared-for, and the variety is impressive. Staff clearly love what they do and are super helpful whether you’re a first-time pet owner or a seasoned pro. Great selection of supplies too. The owner is very passionate about his business and animals. Highly recommend to any animal lover!
Incredibly personable and knowledgable staff, great selection. I've been dealing with these guys since before this location even opened up and I can't recommend them highly enough.
This place is amazing, besides the great prices, the owner is so friendly and knowledgeable! Big fan  10/10
Very helpful and friendly staff!

not recommended at all. the store is not wheelchair accessible.  the owner discriminates against people with disability's. ontop of that this store contracted mites in 2024 the shop has had multiple animals die due to lack of vet care. here is the list. 4 bearded dragons died. a Gouldian finch died. currently there's 2 snakes with mites a blood python and a blue eyed lucy. both have had mites since fall of 2024. on top of that the thousands of fish that have died due to ich because they don't clean there tanks regularly and when they do its minimal cleaning.  also their boarder services, ask to see where your animal is going to be boarded cause it aint pretty.  multiple escapes in the past and probably more to come in the future.

all in all this shop ticks all the boxes of what makes a pet shop no good. use caution and support other reputable stores.
Super cool store, helpful and knowledgeable owner. Will definitely be one of my main shops for aquarium stock and supplies.

Amazing store and super knowledgeable staff! They made sure to answer any questions and helped pick out everything I needed as a first time snake owner. I got this baby corn snake (he’s getting used to his new home now) and we couldn’t be happier!!!

Thanks again Josh and the team!
Josh is a great guy and always super helpful. Glad to have his business in Cabbagetown.

The shrimp are also beautiful and a good adult size. I compared prices and shipping with other places, and this one is the best so far. Highly recommend!

Our cool neighbours! In addition to all the rad reptiles/fish to browse AND their large pet product selection..they carry delicious Local Wildflower Honey. This honey has become a staple in the FTJCo kitchen..
Super knowledgable, friendly and professional!

The Beastiary is a great independent exotic pet shop with knowledgeable and helpful staff. If you are a reptile/amphibian/fish (etc) owner, this is the place for you. I'm a long time customer and will continue to be in the years to come.

Helpful, friendly staff and the store carries every type of pet supply you could want.

This is my absolute favorite pet shop in Toronto. I love going in there because it has such a great atmosphere and the owner and his staff are so friendly and helpful. They are always in a great mood and can pretty much answer any question you throw at them about nutrition and what kind of food is the best and so on. Always a treat going there and seeing them.

The coolest reptile shop I’ve ever been in. Such a wide variety of species and the staff are great. Honestly some of the friendliest pet store staff I’ve met and super knowledgeable. They always make sure the animal comes before profit which is needed more in this industry.
Amazing pet shop! My favorite in the city! The owner Josh in incredibly knowledgeable and has a wide variety of reptiles and fish!
Best pet shop in Toronto!

I am always down to talk about The Beastiary! This is the BEST pet store in toronto! Josh really cares and you can see the difference when it comes to things like the betta fish who are given thier own display tanks! They have the natural chews for my dog and then when it comes to reptiles and bioactive enclosures they have everything you could ever need! The store has such a welcoming vibe and just viewing the plants and animals and being around pet lovers is a fun time! I recommend this shop to EVERYONE because its my favourite spot in the city and I dont know who i would be if i hadnt fallen in love with geckos and The Beastiary! So if you have a pet of any kind, furry to scaly, or you simply want to learn and view, I highly recommend you check out this shop!
We had a great experience there! I went with my 5yo to get a betta fish and they were attentive and kind. My daughter was really happy :) Thank you, we will be back!

We absolutely love this store and the owner! We had a betta fish before (from a different store) and unfortunately it didn’t last long, so this time we decided to come here - and we’re so glad we did. The owner took the time to explain everything in detail about how to properly care for the fish, gave us helpful tips on feeding, water changes, and overall maintenance.

You can really tell that they truly care about the animals and about their customers. The service feels very genuine, not just about selling, but about making sure the pets stay healthy and happy.

Amazing store, very kind and knowledgeable owner, and such a great attitude toward customers. We will definitely come back, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for healthy fish and honest advice!
Awesome animals and wide range of products! Staff were amazing and super patient showing us around
Best exotic pet store hands down! Knowledgable staff that care about their customers. Josh walked me through my first bioactive set up ‘ and me and my crestie couldnt be more happy!

I’ve been to The Beastiary Pet Shop a few times now, and every visit has been a great experience. The store is always clean, well-organized, and has an amazing selection for reptiles, as well as cats and dogs. You can really tell they care about the animals and the quality of their products.
Josh is always very friendly and welcoming. He takes the time to answer questions and never makes you feel rushed, which I really appreciate.
All of the employees are very knowledgeable, kind, and genuinely helpful. It makes a big difference knowing you can trust their advice.
Whether you’re experienced or just starting out, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommend — I’ll definitely keep coming back!

I always like going to this pet store for my fish and aquarium needs. The staff make you feel very comfortable and are generous with their knowledge and assistance. They tested my water for me and told me so much stuff. Also one time there was a big tortoise walking around which was very cool.

Just fyi it’s also just a nice neighbourhood to go to. I dont live there but when I go to the pet store I’ll often eat at one of the nice restaurants on parliament. Make an afternoon of it.
Anyway yeah I definately recommend.

Such a great store! Josh went out of his way to show my kids the pets and even took them out so they could pet them. He was incredibly kind and patient. Customer service like that is rare these days. I highly recommend this shop — truly top-notch, friendly service!
Great place! Friendly staff!

Fingers crossed 🤞 my tank is looking better already and I'm glad they educated me to be a better fish/ aquarium owner. I'll keep you gentlemen updated on tank conditions 😊 oh lastly, watching these guys work was great, other than all the knowledge they have, they truly care about all the creatures in their shop and take very good care of each and every single one of them! It's really nice to see a pet store that actually cares about the animals they have in store. Keep up the great works gents!

It takes me over 1.5 hours to get to the store from where I live but it's still my first choice for anything reptile-related. They have very high standards for care and their animals always look healthy and happy.

Their staff are also very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful and I've really come to trust their advice. Although I've never bought an animal here myself, I've seen a few interactions between staff and people looking to get an animal and I've always been very impressed with the information they're passing on about the animals. Not only is it accurate and up-to-date but they also consider what the client is looking for in order to make personalized recommendations.

I've been coming here for nearly a year now and they've been excellent. I recently boarded my leopard gecko for a couple weeks. It was my first time leaving him for that long so I was a bit nervous but he was very well taken care of!

You won't find a better store. They are people who care about animals not just making a dollar on them. All their enclosures and aquariums are incredible. That doesn't even include the floor to ceiling 5 ft by 10 ft bird and lizard pavilion. Show up at the right time and you can catch the lizard feeding. I live near a pet smart that is easier to get to but I go out of my way to visit this place. Beyond helpful and willing to make sure your animals thrive when you take them home. They personally have answered my questions for an hour at a time regarding planted aquariums. Do yourself a favour and visit them at least once.
Really great experience getting two pet rats here for my son. The staff were very knowledgeable about the proper care of rats so that they are healthy, happy and social.

The Beastiary is a great little store!

I moved downtown a little under a week ago, and they have become my go-to for all things reptile and fish. In store they have a great selection of fish food and supplies and all the reptile feeders you could need. The staff were super welcoming and kind. Their point system is pretty decent as well!

I picked up eight Lampeyes and they're very good quality. They ate for me already and have settled in with my existing school no problem over the day.

He was super nice and helpful and gave up some samples of dog food for our pup when we came in.
These guys really have a passion and love for animals and it really shows.
Our Green keeled belly lizard is so sweet! Thanks guys!

I recently visited The Beastiary Pet Shop in Toronto and had a fantastic experience. The store is filled with a wide variety of exotic pets, including reptiles, amphibians, and fish. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about their animals, and they were more than happy to answer all of my questions.
Josh and Eric were especially helpful and friendly. They took the time to show me around the store and introduce me to some of the animals. They were also very informative about the care and feeding of these creatures.
I highly recommend The Beastiary Pet Shop to anyone looking for a unique and exciting pet experience. The staff is top-notch, and the selection of animals is impressive.

P.S. I visit the shop very frequently to purchase bugs and treats for my bearded dragon. I strongly recommend visiting the shop. They have the friendliest staffs ever!
Was very impressed with staff's knowledge and recommendations. All the creatures seem very content in their specialized homes too.

Shoutout to Josh for the best customer service! Just bought my froggy from here and I love it! Will be a returning customer for sure!

The Beastiary is truly a standout. The staff are always incredibly helpful, friendly, and most importantly—knowledgeable. Whether you’re looking for advice on products, have questions about pet care, or just need help finding something, they go above and beyond to assist.

It’s clear that the team genuinely cares about what they do and takes the time to make sure every customer feels supported and informed. The store is well-organized, clean, and stocked with a wide range of high-quality supplies.

If you’re looking for a place that combines expertise with great customer service, this is it. Highly recommend to anyone who wants a reliable and welcoming pet supply store experience!

Would avoid in the future if it was not the only reptile friendly store within 45 minutes travel time.
Awesome, knowledgeable staff!

I've purchased everything needed for a few fish tanks- tanks, heaters, filters, sand, food, water treatment and different species of fish, and a variety of plants. The friendly and knowledgeable staff have been helpful as I was a complete beginner. They offer courtesy water testing which has been crucial, and their prices are fair. They also have a loyalty purchasing program whereby you can apply points earned through purchases towards future purchases. Multiple staff are experienced fish keepers. I've also bought dog treats from them. Thanks Josh and everyone.

Too friendly staff!! I find ball pythons really cute, but was sceptical about how they would feel to touch and handling, and the staff there just let me handle any reptile I want without hesitation, and after actually knowing they literally feel smooth and soft like some silk or cotton, I am even more excited to have them, this is a very nice gesture to let visitors handle the reptiles, because a lot of people like me think they feel hard and rough like a sand paper, and miss out on a beautiful experience of having a pet reptile, this type of small things encourage new people to engage in this hobby, great work guys!👍
best pet shop in the world.
Very knowledgeable people and amazing supplies! I highly recommend them! Thank you Tom and Josh for all the help!

The animals in store (fish, amphibians, and reptiles) all appear to be well cared for, though the selection is modest (again, small store).

Staff is friendlt and knowledgeable about products and they can do water testing for you if you don't own a water test kit yourself.

Prices are a bit above what you might find at Big Box pet stores or through Amazon, but I try to shop locally owned, so I don't mind.

Nice store for shopping all your pet needs. Josh is an excellent guy who has a ton of knowledge & is more than willing share for your pets. His companion at the shop, Erick is also a very helpful. Good luck!

The Beastiary Pet Shop takes the care of our animal companions seriously, with well curated quality products. From grain-free cat food to Omega supplementary oil to add to food, to amazing cat litter (yes, I said amazing) 😉. …
